"The real world is more amazing than anything you can make up!"

Welcome to our What on Earth! YouTube channel, featuring book trailers, author interviews, illustrator profiles, virtual talks and more! As well as magazine content, competitions and offers.

What on Earth publishes books that allow children to explore their natural curiosity and passion for learning.
